description.value: The Main on Main is a long-running neighbourhood restaurant and live music venue that has served Mediterranean, Western, and Italian classics since 1997. The space features warehouse-height ceilings, steel beams, and wood floors, giving it a rustic, unhurried atmosphere where regulars linger. An extensive cocktail, wine, and draft beer list — including local BC craft ales — rounds out the food and music experience.

The website also notes the location is 'at the corner of East 26th Ave. & Main Street', so 4210 Main Street appears to be the correct primary address.
